 Can Villa cause an upset at Barcelona? 
 Published 36 minutes ago 
 BBC Radio WM reporter Mike Taylor is in Barcelona and speaking to Aston Villa supporters ahead of tonight's Champions League match at the Spotify Camp Nou. 
 How do they think Unai Emery's side will get on? Take a look below and remember, you can listen to full commentary of Barcelona v Aston Villa on BBC Radio WM [95.6FM] .
 And don't forget to tune into The West Midlands Football Phone-In from 18:00 on weeknights. 
 Image caption, Alfie: I think we've got more chance winning here than we have against Manchester United on Sunday as we always seem to struggle there! It's winnable so we have to go for it.
 Image caption, Ash and Nav: I'm not sure about the result because Barcelona are on a good run of form at the minute, but who knows if we can cause an upset. Our Champions League form is incredible.
 Image caption, Andrew: Even though it's a bit of a building site at the moment, the stadium is magnificent. We've been to the 2-2 draw at Shrewsbury Town so let's see how we get on! In Emery we trust and the squad rebuild looks fantastic. Everyone is going to be fired up. 
 Image caption, Iona: This is something special! 
 David: I think we will score, but it's whether they score more than us. I really think we have a chance [to win]. 
 Listen to full commentary of Barcelona v Aston Villa on BBC Radio WM [95.6FM] 
 And tune into The West Midlands Football Phone-In from 18:00 on weeknights
